hypothesis: native_forward optimizes triplet identity on normalized pre-BN projection,while current candidate banks normalize post-BN features. Both are valid feature locations;their difference alone is not a proven bug or gain.
frames: 64 uniformly spaced predetermined frames from each of all6Train videos,384total;every actual cached detector proposal on those frames. No GT crop or new detections.
inference: Same frozen independently trained RGB/IR encoders,FP32,same images/crops and batch32;compare normalized projection before/after BN. Verify post-BN max absolute difference<=1e-3 against existing FP16 bank and all weights/BN unchanged.
producer_labels: GPU producers cannot read GT. Separate CPU consumer joins current-frame Train labels only after all GPU producers finish.
diagnostic: First3 reliable known actual proposal observations per identity in first75% of each original video form templates;last25% reliable known positives are queries. Encoder already saw Train identities;this is a feature-location diagnostic,not fresh generalization or tracking HOTA.

progress_gates.RGB: preBN minus postBN equal-video retrieval>=2points and improvements on>=4of6Train videos
progress_gates.paired: preBN paired minus preBN RGB retrieval>=1point and improvements on>=4of6Train videos

next_if_positive: Create an independently source-pinned fullTrain and fullDev preBN bank within existing64GiB cap;refit/calibrate on actual allTrain candidates;fullDev gate before any Test. Keep old postBN results and matchedRGB/missing/permutation controls.
